data.name: JUMPER : SPEEDRUN
data.detailed_description:
JUMPER : SPEEDRUN is an FPS Platformer game. The player will travel from point A to point B. You'll be forced to avoid many traps like Lasers, Mines and many other traps in order to reach your goal. Also there is Puzzles in the game you must solve.
You will find upgrade points in some levels to upgrade and unlock new Abilities to help you in this game
The game gets Harder and harder as you progress

Features:
  • Unlock different abilities like Slowing time, Boost, Shields, Jump Pads and many more !!
  • Solve puzzles to pass some levels
  • Beautiful music
  • About 40 Levels

    EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO MASTER
    WILL YOU ACCEPT THE CHALLENGE ?

reviews.review:
If you look at my hours on record compared to most other reviewers you can tell I have a little bit more experience than most. Though this game does have its downsides, It was free, compared to other $15 games such as Deadcore or Cyber Hook. There is a stark difference, if you have the available money, I recommend you look to those. However for a free abandoned game, I love it. 

First thing's first, if you want to play this game rebound your jump key to your scroll wheel. Pressing the spacebar to jump is frustrating and not conducive to a fun time. I have been speedrunning this game myself but not publishing times anywhere, just as fun for me.

The look is very sterile reminiscent of portal only giving you enough information to understand where to go. There are challenge levels where everything is one color and you aren't allowed to touch anything which are very fun and interspersed in a good amount to not be too frustrating. Though there is only music on certain levels, if you come into it seeing it as what it was which is an unfinished game, it is more than adequate.

The biggest downsides are some of the glitches that are still in the game, in certain walls on rare occasions if you start falling down it recognizes it as a hit even though there is no floor. You don't really notice it until you're on your 3rd or 4th run through the game. There is a good combination of challenge, speed and "puzzle" maps. There is an introductory level to each new concept that allows you to understand it in a safe environment. The game has a nice scale of difficulty with some breaks in between to cool off.

The biggest downside to the game are the glitches, none of them render the game unplayable but they definitely become frustrating if you don't know what's going on.

Overall the mechanics are interesting, the difficulty curve is exciting and well paced, the challenge levels are a nice interspersed section. I would recommend this game, just know what you are signing up for. If you go in with "unfinished free game" expectations, you won't be disappointed.

Feel free to message me if you decide to pick this game up and give it a go, I love to make new friends!
